relations: Right cloud's pointed summit lowers and rounds out, opening a backlit gap while the cloud mass remains stationary.
As the right cloud silhouette reshapes, crepuscular rays fan toward the upper left, shifting in angle and intensity.
Lower cloud bank's rim highlights and wisps undergo minor, gradual evolution without overall drift across the frame.
Camera and diagonal power lines hold a constant position relative to the frame edges throughout the sky evolution.
caption: The video captures a fixed outdoor view of a bright blue sky dominated by a large backlit cumulus cloud on the right, the sun hidden so that crepuscular rays fan toward the upper left. A shadowed cloud bank fills the bottom-left, two thin power lines run diagonally across the lower third, and a touch of foliage sits at the corner. The camera and the power lines hold a constant position relative to the frame edges throughout. The summit of the right-hand cloud slowly reshapes, its pointed tower lowering and rounding out, and a bright backlit gap opens at the top, changing the silhouette without the cloud translating. The fan of rays subtly shifts in angle and intensity as the cloud edge evolves, the leftmost bands repositioning slightly. Small wisps and rim highlights on the lower bank undergo minor, gradual evolution, with no overall drift of the cloud masses. The apparent motion is cloud and light evolution, not camera movement.
